shared_elements: horizontal band/line dividing the surface into registers
a row of repeated similar motifs along the top
tall rounded-topped upright slab format with carving confined to the face
justification: Both surfaces organise profile relief figures into stacked horizontal registers separated by a ruled band, with a row of repeated similar motifs across the top, which is the strongest correspondence but a very common compositional device. What is depicted differs almost completely: A shows animals alone (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form, a horned/beaked head) with no humans, while B shows exclusively human figures seated and standing around laden offering tables accompanied by rows of sign-like marks, rendered in a linear, garment-detailing manner unlike A's blocky bold-relief beasts.
